page_title: LIL 1-1 PSG | Lille v PSG 05/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+5' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
88' Benjamin Andre (Lille) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
85' 1 - 1 Ethan Mbappe (Lille) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home low into the middle of the net. The goalkeeper was helpless.
83' Close! Achraf Hakimi (PSG) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the right post.
81' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the right post.
81' Substitution. Mathias Fernandez-Pardo did his best and is replaced by Ethan Mbappe (Lille).
81' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

81' That was a nice football moment. Kang-In Lee (PSG) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the roof of the net. Berke Ozer guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
76' Bruno Genesio has decided to substitute Olivier Giroud and he is replaced by Hamza Igamane (Lille).
76' Here's the change. Thomas Meunier leaves the pitch and Tiago Santos (Lille) comes on as a substitute.

75' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker!
71' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
68' Luis Enrique has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) replacing Lucas Hernandez.
66' Felix Correia (Lille) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hakon Arnar Haraldsson.
66' Here is a change. Nabil Bentaleb is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
66' 0 - 1 Nuno Mendes (PSG) scores a beautiful goal from the resulting free kick. He bends the ball into the top right corner. A technically stunning goal.
62' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahim Mbaye trots off the pitch and is replaced by Achraf Hakimi (PSG).
59' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Bradley Barcola will be replaced by Nuno Mendes (PSG).
59' Substitution. Vitinha (PSG) on for Senny Mayulu.
57' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

57' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball goes out of play. Lille are awarded a corner kick.

56' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Berke Ozer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
55' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
50' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
48' Kang-In Lee (PSG) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
46' Olivier Giroud (Lille) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Bastien starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' What was Lucas Hernandez (PSG) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+1' The corner from Senny Mayulu (PSG) is cleared away by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Bradley Barcola (PSG) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
43' What a big chance! Bradley Barcola (PSG) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
38' Bradley Barcola (PSG) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.

38' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
35' Quentin Ndjantou (PSG) makes a strong challenge and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
33' Romain Perraud (Lille) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
33' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) works the corner short.
32' Wow, what an escape. Thomas Meunier (Lille) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
31' PSG take a short corner kick.
31' Lucas Hernandez (PSG) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to PSG.

26' Bradley Barcola (PSG) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
24' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

24' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play and Lille manage to earn a corner.
23' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille). The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
20' Kang-In Lee (PSG) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
18' Kang-In Lee (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
18' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
14' Senny Mayulu (PSG) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
14' Bradley Barcola (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Senny Mayulu (PSG) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
11' Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
7' Aissa Mandi (Lille) tackles a bit over-zealously and Benoit Bastien blows for a foul.
5' Romain Perraud (Lille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
2' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Lille will kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will referee today's match.
